column1: # The rules that the files of the writing pack own, as data.
# columns: rule, owner, class, load and phrase. Grove's
# checks with this manifest alone and in the aggregate with core.
# Each owner is a file that this pack ships. A rule ID is unique across this
# manifest and every manifest that a run supplies.

column5: Do not introduce a medium the contract does not name
Every figure states its role
a contract's medium is reopened by that record and by nothing else
a structural finding is sent back as a `draft` re-run leaf, never fixed here
A figure of speech replaced by the mechanism it stood for
If this document has no structure brief, stop and say so
The existence of a node file is not the test
every claim about the subject is checked against the subject
a **producer, not a reviewer**
changes only what its own charter owns
recorded and passed on, **never absorbed**
unless a live later sibling under this node already holds that stage
Do not skip a stage because you judge it will find nothing
carries the document's bare stem as its whole slug
under a running `## Handed forward` list naming the owning stage
a **contiguous run** that begins at the owning stage and ends at `proof`
A second re-run of one stage against one document is an escalation, not a third leaf
The next stage is not that review
passing whatever gate the repository runs over it
coherence across the whole document
An entry left in the list when this stage retires is a defect nobody owns
the node closes when a `proof` retires having sent nothing back
a proof session that finds nothing has still done its job
